description:
Amendment 0001: Remove/Replace Page 1 of SF1442.  This corrects bid submittal deadline to reflect 04/24/2026; 1000CT.

Project Title: Lake Wedington Waterline Construction, ARKANSAS

Original Set Aside: Total Small Business Set-Aside (FAR 19.5)

NAICS Code: 237110 Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction

PSC: Z2NE REPAIR OR ALTERATION OF WATER SUPPLY FACILITIES

Type of Contract: This is a Invitation for Bid (IFB) which will result in award of a firm-fixed price contract. Award will be made to the lowest responsive, responsible bidder.

Magnitude: The magnitude of this project is between: $1M and $2M.

Location:  Lake Wedington Recreation Area, Fayetteville, Arkansas; Ozark-St. Francis National Forests. entrance gate to Lake Wedington Rec Area (west of Fayetteville, AR -off AR State Hwy 16). See Attachment 001through 003 for complete details.

Scope of Work: This project will include elements from two separate designs: complete replacement of existing distribution lines (Package 001) and new potable water supply line (Package 002). The distribution system includes demolition of existing lines and valves and installation of approximately 16,000 linear feet of waterline (sizes range from 1-inch to 6-inch) from the existing Forest Service 22,000-gallon water storage tank to the day-use area and campground. The supply line includes installation of approximately 6000 linear feet of 3-inch waterline from Krie Road to the existing Forest Service 22,000-gallon water storage tank.

Schedule and Deadlines:

Site Visit: 10 Mar 2026, 1000CT. Offerors are highly encouraged to attend the site visit. Meet at the entrance gate to Lake Wedington Rec Area (west of Fayetteville, AR - off AR State Hwy 16). USFS Point of Contact is Danny Sims (479) 223-2176, danny.sims@usda.gov. RVSP is requested by 07 Mar 2026 so we don't leave anyone behind!!!

Questions Deadline: 27 Mar 2026. Questions shall be submitted via email to steven.alves@usda.gov; cc: adam.doyle@usda.gov and are due no later than March 27th, 2026. The subject line should read: 12445126B0010 QUESTION.

Bids Deadline: 24 Apr 2026 - 1000 CT. All bids shall be received by 1000 CT and emailed to steven.alves@usda.gov cc: adam.doyle@usda.gov. Subject Line: 12445126B0010 BID_Co.

Name Period for acceptance of offers. The Offeror agrees to hold the prices in its offer firm for 90 calendar days from the date specified for receipt of offers.

Period of Performance: 160 days after award/Completion no later than 30 Sep 2026
